धिव (इ) धिवि r. 1st and 5th cls. (धिनोति)
 1. To please, to satisfy.
 2. To
be pleased or satisfied.
 3. To go or approach: this verb takes उ,
and substitutes अ for the final, whence its unusual form for the
first class, in the instance given. प्रीणने अक० गतौ च सक० स्वा० पर०
सेट् इदित् । सार्वधातुके धिः आदेशः ।

धीवन् m. (-वा)
 1. A brazier.
 2. A fisherman.
 E. धृ to hold, Uṇādi affix
कनिन् and ऋ changed to ई.

धीवर m. (-रः) A fisherman.
 f. (-री)
 1. A fisherman's wife.
 2. A sort of
harpoon for catching fish with.
 E. धी to hold or gain, (fish,)
Unādi affix ष्वरच्.
